scope: single-seed development optimization; no independent test or isolated attribution

finetuning_metadata.information_assumption: instantaneous task summaries and one-hop telemetry; no control-plane cost
finetuning_metadata.routing_information_assumption: shared rule service: current global graph/queues and predicted contacts

initialization.rng: new run seed; not exact continuation

finetuning_metadata.selection: validation equal-weight task-age delivery score, then restricted mean latency

scenario_distribution.scope: continuous training randomization; disjoint orbital time blocks

limitations: BC and PPO benefits reported separately
greedy is strongest measured local baseline, not global optimum or literature SOTA
teacher estimates may disagree with commitment and result-relay execution semantics
